## Purpose
One-click revision prompts derived from validation issue codes, with no LLM. When nothing is wrong, it offers general improvements instead.

## Responsibilities
- **`_BY_CODE`** maps 22 issue codes to instruction templates with `{step}`. For example, `agent.missing_binding` gives "Bind step '{step}' to an existing agent that can do its job, or give it a model and instructions of its own.". Copy the table verbatim.
- **`_IMPROVEMENTS`** are four prompts:
  - "Add a human review step…";
  - "Run the steps that do not depend on each other in parallel.";
  - "Validate the inputs at the very start…";
  - "Remove any step that does not contribute…".
- **`suggestions_for(issues, limit=6)`:**
  - errors come first, de-duplicated by prompt;
  - each suggestion is `{kind: "fix", severity, code, step_id, title (the message), prompt}`;
  - otherwise it returns the improvements.
- **`_prompt(code, step_id, message)`** uses the template when its step is known, else "Fix this[ in 'step']: <message>".

## Key elements
`suggestions_for`, `_BY_CODE`.
